fullSource:
use default

let letters = ['a', 'b', 'c']
let capitals = ['A', 'B', 'C']
let digits = [1, 2, 3]

letters
    |> zip(capitals, (letter, capital) => "{letter}{capital}")
    |> zip(digits, (pair, digit) => "{pair}{digit}")
    |> each(row => write_line(row))
